name: agent-headless
description: One typed headless interface for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor Agent, and Antigravity CLIs.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/cli.ts --outdir ./dist --target node --format esm && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.check: bunx tsc --noEmit && bun run test && bun run build && node --test test/node-runtime.test.mjs
scripts.test: bun test test/adapters.test.ts test/runtime.test.ts test/validation.test.ts test/live.test.ts
scripts.prepack: bun run check && bun run build
